notes: **Added:** **Live player counter** - Shows how many players are in-game in the community (may not be fully accurate as the community hasn't fully migrated yet).
**Added:** **Background volume control** - Diagnostics includes a slider to adjust launcher background music volume; the setting is remembered for next launch.
**Changed:** **Default background volume** - Starting background music level is **half** of the previous default (50% lower) so the UI is less loud on new installs.

**Removed:** **Common Error Fixes** (Diagnostics) - Removed the License Manager / Xbox Networking / SFC quick-fix actions and related IPC; service checks still appear in diagnostics, with manual steps when something is stopped.
**Removed:** **GPU Checker** (Diagnostics) - Removed the separate "detected graphics hardware" panel from the diagnostics screen (full diagnostics still report GPU in the main results).

**Added:** **AntHill LIVE (AHL) server toggle** - Diagnostics includes a Server Configuration switch: leave it off for Microsoft's original GFWL endpoints, or turn it on for AntHill LIVE. Missing AHL patcher files are downloaded and extracted automatically when needed (`AHL Files.zip` from releases).

**Improved:** **Main process structure** - Refactored the large `main.js` into smaller, purpose-built modules (window, downloads, game, diagnostics, updater, activation, logging, and more) so the launcher is easier to maintain and review. User-facing behavior is intended to stay the same.

**Improved:** **Logging** - Main process uses a single `safeLog` pipeline (electron-log); logs are written to `%APPDATA%\Shadowrun FPS Launcher\logs\main.log` (rotates to `main.old.log` at 1 MB) for support and debugging.
**Improved:** **Activation & support code** - Game activation, PCID tools, and .NET 6 / helper logic now live in dedicated files; the flow and steps were not redesigned, only relocated.
**Added:** **Update Error Notifications** - Comprehensive error messages for download failures with specific error type detection (network, timeout, server errors, etc.)
**Added:** **Download Timeout Detection** - Automatic detection of stalled downloads with 3-minute timeout and user notification
**Added:** **Update Retry Functionality** - One-click retry button for failed downloads without needing to re-check for updates
**Added:** **Installation Failure Detection** - Automatic detection of failed update installations on app restart with detailed error messages
**Added:** **Manual Download Fallback** - Direct download link option when auto-update fails, opens installer in browser
**Improved:** **Update Error Handling** - Enhanced error classification and user-friendly error messages with troubleshooting guidance
**Improved:** **Update Download Reliability** - Progress tracking prevents silent failures and provides clear feedback during downloads
**Improved:** **Update Installation Verification** - Automatic verification of successful installations on app restart with success confirmation
**Improved:** **Update User Experience** - Improved error dialogs with retry, manual download, and close options for better user control
**Added:** **Find Existing Location** - Manually select existing game files if located in a different location
**Improved:** **Game Path Persistence** - Selected game folder is now remembered across sessions and window focus changes
**Improved:** **Folder Name Independence** - Launcher works with any folder name as long as Shadowrun.exe is present
**Improved:** **Dynamic Mod Status Updates** - Mod statuses (Skip Intro, DXVK, FPS, srs_shadowrun.dll) automatically update after selecting game location
**Improved:** **Window Focus Re-checking** - Launcher automatically detects when game files are moved or renamed while launcher is running
**Added:** **Change Game Location** - Move game files to a different location after initial download
**Added:** **GPU Driver Update Detection** - Automatically detects GPU vendor and opens appropriate software
**Added:** **System File Checker (SFC) with UAC** - Run Windows SFC scan with UAC elevation
**Added:** **Launcher Visibility Management** - Launcher automatically hides when game launches
**Improved:** **Game File Move Operations**
**Improved:** **UI/UX Enhancements**
**Added:** Changelog Modal & History
**Added:** DXVK Support toggle for better compatibility
**Added:** srs_shadowrun.dll version switcher (newer/older)
**Added:** System diagnostics and troubleshooting tools
**Added:** Automatic updates
**Improved:** Game activation with auto-injection
**Improved:** File download progress tracking
